notes.title: 18.07.2024 -- Update of Pause Button
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

It's been over two years since the last update? Wow, it's been a while, hasn't it? 
There were plans to make an update (last year) with a Hungarian language translation of the game, but it didn't work out, sorry!
But that's okay, here's the current update!
See what changes are now in the game:
[list]
[*] - The text of the information in the log is now different, hopefully the readability is better now. [i](Grey text on a grey background? Designer genius! (sarcasm))[/i]
[*] - Fixed a couple of bugs related to the pause menu*.
[*] - Fixed sound volume on the buttons in the settings menu. [i](was very quiet)[/i]
[*] - Fixed AZERTY \ QUERTY change.
[*] - Added backing for gamepad artwork and text in settings. This was needed to get rid of a graphical bug.
[*] - Added UI button to call pause! [i]Wow, 5 years after release? Really?[/i]
[*] - Various sounds to buttons in settings added. I think the settings menu sounds now.
[*] - Compass navigator has been changed. Used to only spell out one letter-side of the world. Now 3 are written and there is an animation of the rotation of these sides.
[*] - Now when changing the resolution shows ‘*’ and flickers the button ‘accept’ so that you, the player, pay attention to it.
[*] - The main menu now shows the game version.
[*] - Various fixes for little things.
[/list]

* The bug still creeps in sometimes, still trying to find a solution.

Screenshots of new elements:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/29364393ab7db412d580a9adf4afbc51522178d0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/90bca7fd46f19cd50bd1b515b2006bc07704caef.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/b0582466b85d2bd34e3dd88f479efdb188ebbf87.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/8696d50c06cca8c288fd41a43e982a28ec62812f.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for your interest in the game! It means a lot to me!

notes.title: 2021 may 15. Minor update
notes.content: A minor update includes a small visual improvement for gamepad-text input, and mushrooms now reduces the effect of eaten item characteristics (should help when you're faced with a negative damage situation).

notes.title: Update and improved gamepad
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]
	
I would like to present you an update on the improved gamepad input! [i](Yes, once again)[/i]

[list]
[b][i]New:[/i][/b]
	[*] Added gamepad layouts.

[i]This option can be turned off. I recommend using layout number 1, which is what brings the new improved input.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/f36f0d127866c59cd61e92ace1ce7740aeaa965f.png[/img]
	[*] You can now enter your character name using the gamepad! (finally!) 

[i]Petal-input is used, similar to the one used in Steam.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/0d54b2d59717a4f8d95fb1c6ea6d481efcbf82ea.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/9dda7cf6e41a7237b4c9ae407aaa8af23961f863.gif[/img]

	[*] The game menus are more adapted to the gamepad: meta-menu, skill tree and INVENTORY.

[i]It is now easier to manage inventory using the gamepad - use the "lock on inventory" button and then use the d-pad to select a cell.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/6cec1f627bbe367ac2224399bd859803b9db6f60.gif[/img]

	[*] The "back" button has been added to meta-menu, character creation and settings menu.
	[*] A visual effect has been added when you open the SkillPad so you can see it better (if you haven't noticed it).
	[*] Added an icon indicator to show that the dungeon has been "cleared".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/79f2b5d94e2e684093fe184f1f228300ab9d5046.png[/img]
	[*] Asynchronous saving and loading.
[i]Please let me know if you have any errors with this new system.[/i]
[/list]

[list]
[b][i]Improvments:[/i][/b]
	[*] A visual area has been added where you need to put the knife to throw it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34129155/48bfb25aefb8d6bec722c37ee455a9cbb3d5ed9c.png[/img]

	[*] Knives can now be bought from a dealer.
[/list]
[list]
[b][i]Fixed bugs:[/i][/b]
	[*] Limitation of turnaround speed with high agility
	[*] "Double bat" bug.
	[*] When an enemy is killed by a fire spell, experience is now given.
	[*] A bug with health recovery when eating an item. 
	[*] Minor-bugs
[/list]


	You may also know that the game has already been released on the RedSwitcher thanks to the publisher.
	I am pleased to announce that the game will soon be available on the GreenBox and BlueStation.

notes.title: Balance Improvements (sort of)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129155/d4f1648af55f0b6cf3082737c9603c9bc666f6ee.gif[/img]

Well, I tried to correct the situation with the "eating stats" ability.

[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Eating Stats. Now you get not only a bonus stats, but also a "negative effect" [b]*[/b]
[*] Eating Stats. Also added “stamina” to eating items. Now you can not throw all items in your mouth, hungry hero!
[*] Now items of the same type can have different prices. Hooray!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129155/34be13bfb7cdfd9882195a6fdc5bfbe11835e23f.png[/img]

[b]Other improvements or fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Display multiple stamina bars
[*] It was very lonely in the forest. It seems an bug with a small number of enemies fixed
[*] Fixed a bug with "one cell dungeon" in the "cave" location
[/list]

[b]*[/b] [i]Negative effect.[/i]
if you eat the sword "+2 damage", you will probably get "-2 dexterity", for example. It is chosen randomly depending on the type of item, but sometimes it can be random within the same type.


ALSO in the "beta mode" added a [b]Spanish[/b] translation!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129155/71ec84aeb0a1b61369fa21459e5fdc3f36483d3e.png[/img]

[i]Bug fixes will continue...[/i]

notes.title: Improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129155/d18f0007da7a0731bbd6ec6154a107cdd69704f3.gif[/img]

[b]User interface improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Highlighting items and slots in the inventory
[*] Improved mouse input for scrolling a list of items (NPC-shop, meta-menu)
[*] In Meta-menu now displays the hint of the “Well-eater”
[*] In the bonus menu, you can now select a picture with the cursor
[*] In the pause menu, "Exit" is replaced by "Save and Exit" for better understanding
[*] Some NPCs have their own color on the mini-map
[*] Fixed a bug where in the log the name of an item with a level was displayed by more than one line
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievement "bestiary" fixed (Sorry!). Now it is not necessary to fulfill the condition in one session.
[*] In control settings, the scroller and mouse click is fixed
[*] Fixed "freezing" in main menu (very rare)
[*] Very rare game crash when you purchase an item from a trader
[*] Now, if the NPC cannot give you an item, then written to the log that there is not enough space in the inventory
[*] Fixed a bug in the forest when mushrooms and chests were created on the same cell
[*] Minor bugs
[*] Fixed some lines in English
[/list]

[i]Something like a balance change:[/i]
[list]
[*] 1 gold heals only 1 health point
[*] Now the skill "eating" has 5 levels instead of 1 previously.
The restoration of health from items now depends on the level of skill "eating"
[*] Now, depending on the strength, your damage will be a little random
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129155/c2bc24e14a1251686eee52afbe2d92078315ad64.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129155/90e09d2e8978d5198ac49297de1d10b64b2f9c61.gif[/img]

[i]Known bugs and what's next:[/i]
[list]
[*] Balance[strike], balance never changes [/strike]
[*] [bugs] Phantom enemies and / or chests
[*] [plans] Perhaps there will be an endless "dungeon" - a maze
[/list]

Special thanks to [b]Mark Alan[/b] for his activity in bug-reports!
